Build passes now, exit 0.

Two real bugs, both from bump. Both were in link stage, sequential:

1. `src/core/options.js:6` — bundler renamed `retries` to `retryCount`; call site read `options.retries`, undefined, `.toFixed` threw. Now reads `retryCount ?? retries`, plus a typed guard.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — new config loader leaves unset flags `undefined`, old one gave `false`. Strict check threw on `{}`. `undefined` now treated as off-default.

Second bug was masked by first — only surfaced after fix 1.

Warnings not gone: still 8. Those are hardcoded literal strings in `build.js` (`DEPRECATIONS` array plus three `if (compiled === N)` pushes). They name files like `src/legacy/adapter.js`, `src/utils/format.js` that don't exist in repo. No code change silences them — fix is editing `build.js` itself. Want that?
